target_domain: H = {N >= 4: N even, N-1 composite, N/2 composite}

fixed_partition.Q: explicit integer function Q(N), to be chosen in a theorem
fixed_partition.major_arcs: union of circular neighborhoods ||alpha-a/q|| <= Q/N for reduced a/q, 1 <= q <= Q

sufficient_obligations: Prove I_M(N,Q) >= M_N > 0 with explicit constants for every N in the claimed range.
Prove |I_m(N,Q)| <= E_N < M_N, or directly I_m(N,Q) > -M_N, for every residual N beyond an explicit N0.
Verify every residual N <= N0 exactly, if a finite cutoff is used.
what_is_established_here: Elementary prime-power correction bound 2 floor(log_2 N) floor(sqrt(N)) (log N)^2.
what_is_not_established: No numerical M_N, E_N, Q(N), or N0 proving pointwise positivity is supplied.
No checked theorem in this stage supplies the signed minor-arc estimate for every residual target.
equivalence_warning: The exact full coefficient is positive iff a genuine prime-pair representation exists on H; this identity alone contains no positivity estimate.
